eventDetail.scope: The IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing Technology and Science (CloudCom) is a premier forum for researchers, practitioners, and industry experts to exchange and share their experiences, research results, and novel ideas on all aspects of cloud computing. CloudCom brings together leading researchers and practitioners working on cloud computing technologies, architectures, applications, and services. Since its inception, CloudCom has been held annually in cities around the world, bringing together hundreds of researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to discuss the latest advances in cloud computing.
